headline: The biggest day of the year for the Arizona local scene
paragraph_1: For one day only, the Sonoran desert becomes the loudest room in Arizona. Desert Grey is a hand-picked selection of 25+ bands — local legends, rising talent, and acts debuting their sound — playing across three stages at the Nile Theater in downtown Mesa.
paragraph_2: No lanes, no gate-keeping. From acoustic openers at midday to metal at night, the lineup is built like a mixtape: it bends with the temperature.
